source.title: Power of da Water
source.description:
Now dat flood be the worst part, mon. Dat canyon be dry and water flow for days on dat hard cracked ground and the basin be gone in a flash.

Not many elementals, dat I know of,  be containing that type of power, but...

<Bath'rah looks at you with a sly grin.>

You know I gotch'ya back broda.

The mires of Dustwallow Marsh is where you should go. While not purely water elementals, dose withering got secrets.
source.objective: Collect 5 Rushing Essence from the withering elementals in Dustwallow Marsh and bring them to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.
source.completion: Shake dat sludge off, we almost done.
